items.title: Google AI Overviews Surge 58% Across 9 Industries: What the Data Means for Your Search Visibility in 2026
items.summary: AI Overviews grew 58% YoY to 48% of queries across industries like education (83%) and tech (82%), with only 17% of cited sources in organic top 10, slashing CTR by up to 61%. This pushes organic results below the fold, demanding dual optimization for rankings and AI citations via topical depth, E-E-A-T, and structured data. Marketers must prioritize AI visibility alongside traditional SEO to combat traffic loss.

items.title: AI Overviews SEO: How to Rank in Google’s AI Results
items.summary: Appearing in 60% of searches, AI Overviews cut CTR by 58% by summarizing trusted sources directly in SERPs. Optimization involves structured headings, E-E-A-T via experts/citations, schema markup, conversational tone, fresh content, and topical clusters to boost citations. Success metrics shift to AI visibility and quality traffic over volume.

items.title: Google's first Discover algorithm update is complete – and it took three weeks instead of two
items.summary: The February 2026 Discover Core Update extended to three weeks, prioritizing local content, curbing clickbait, and favoring expert original content. With Discover comprising 67.5% of Google mobile traffic to news publishers, it establishes GEO as distinct from SEO, requiring proactive local relevance optimization. Publishers face new traffic dynamics emphasizing expertise over query-based search.

items.title: March 2026 Google Search Observations
items.summary: Ongoing volatility includes up to 80% traffic drops, prolonged Discover effects hitting all sites, and AI Overviews/People Also Ask dominating mobile SERPs, slashing organic clicks. Issues like spam failures and core update echoes persist, shifting traffic to Amazon amid bot surges. SEO must address visibility loss in AI-heavy results and focus on high-engagement content.

items.title: Parents Awarded $1.5M After Supreme Court Win in LGBTQ+ Books Case
items.summary: In Mahmoud v. Taylor, conservative religious parents in Montgomery County, Maryland, secured a $1.5 million settlement against the school board following a 6-3 Supreme Court ruling that opting out of LGBTQ+ themed lessons was a protected religious right. The curriculum included books like Pride Puppy!, depicting a family at Pride Day, and My Rainbow, about a transgender daughter's wig. The settlement mandates parental notifications and opt-out permissions for such content.

items.title: Trade Publishing Contracts Require AI Disclosure
items.summary: Contemporary trade publishing contracts contain clauses mandating authors to disclose any use of AI, with non-disclosure considered a breach of contract. Submissions must go through agents and use digital formats like Word and PDF, evolving from older typewritten methods. This reflects ongoing industry adaptations to AI in writing and editing.

items.title: PMJ Signs Multi-Book Deal with Formerly Self-Published Author Lucinda Berry
items.summary: PMJ has signed a multi-book deal with US thriller author Lucinda Berry, marking her transition from self-publishing to traditional publishing in the UK and Commonwealth territories. Berry expressed honor in partnering with the publisher for her ongoing publishing journey. The agreement covers multiple titles in her thriller catalog.

items.title: The Test of Lionhood - New Christian Children's Book by Kevin Sorbo
items.summary: Brave Books releases 'The Test of Lionhood' by Kevin Sorbo, a Christian children's story where Lucas saves his sister Chloe from poisoning and learns bravery and perseverance from a legendary lion. The book includes interactive elements like the BRAVE Challenge activities. It emphasizes traditional values through its heartwarming narrative and strong Christian messaging.

items.title: ‘Game of Thrones’ prequel actress faced backlash over her race. Here’s how she responded.
items.summary: Tanzyn Crawford, who plays Tanselle in HBO’s ‘A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms,’ received backlash on social media regarding her race after casting announcements. She acknowledged some negativity but emphasized employment and dream pursuit, with support from George R.R. Martin confirming her fit for the role. The series premiered to positive reviews from some fans praising its non-woke focus.

items.title: Scary Movie sequel sparks outrage for mocking woke pronouns: 'They're trying to be offensive!'
items.summary: The Scary Movie 6 trailer features a stabbed victim correcting pronouns to 'they/them,' drawing online outrage from some calling it transphobic and dated. Other fans praised the humor as a return to the franchise's edgy style. Marlon Wayans released the trailer amid vows to combat cancel culture.

items.title: Box Office Preview: Pixar’s ‘Hoppers’ to Bound Past Maggie Gyllenhaal’s ‘The Bride!’
items.summary: Pixar’s ‘Hoppers’ is projected for the largest opening weekend in years for an original Pixar animated feature. It significantly outpaces Maggie Gyllenhaal’s ‘The Bride!,’ which receives poor audience reception. Critics highlight ‘Hoppers’ for blending laughter, compassion, and emotional moments.

items.title: Woke 'Bride!' Feels Like Blast from Cancel Culture Past
items.summary: Maggie Gyllenhaal’s ‘The Bride!’ is described in reviews as a product of peak woke era, resembling cancel culture influences. Critics label it a ‘wokified Joker-fied feminist opera’ with unclear messaging on feminism. The film faced rough test screenings over sexual violence and underperformed at the box office.

items.title: Somehow, Hollywood Reaches A New Low As Woke 'Star Trek' Show Just Keeps Getting Worse
items.summary: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy faces criticism for prioritizing ideology over entertainment, resulting in low viewership and audience rejection. Multiple reports highlight it as a woke flop with no prime audience engagement. Viewers express fatigue with the content direction.

items.title: Rihanna shares video in the studio
items.summary: Rihanna posted a video of herself working in the studio late at night, nearly 10 years after her last album Anti. The clip excited fans worldwide, sparking speculation about upcoming new music. Collaborator Kuk Harrell was spotted, known for hits like Umbrella and Stay.

items.title: 68% of Small Businesses Use AI — But Most Are Winging It
items.summary: 68% of small businesses use AI tools for content generation, customer service chatbots, ad optimization, and marketing analytics, with 78.6% reporting reduced costs or improved efficiency. However, 77% lack a written AI policy, and only 15-20% use it strategically, leading to higher gains (88.9%) for regular users versus experimental ones. This highlights the need for structured AI adoption to maximize benefits and mitigate risks like data exposure.

items.title: The AI Megacycle: Five Forces Reshaping The Venture Market In 2026
items.summary: AI in 2026 is concentrating venture capital around AI-native companies, accelerating growth in vertical applications like law and healthcare that integrate deeply into workflows. It enables small teams to achieve high revenue milestones quickly via efficiency gains, rewriting business economics with higher revenue per employee. This shift impacts small businesses and platforms by favoring scalable AI infrastructure and product moves.
